item.title: Week 10: Seahawks at Raiders
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: SEA -6.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model LV 48% vs. market 28% | The game may turn on whether Las Vegas can finish drives, since the Raiders convert only 58% of red-zone trips against a Seattle defense that allows 67%, a bottom-tier mark. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the player to watch, drawing 35% of Seattle's targets and running into a Las Vegas pass defense ranked 32nd. Our model puts Seattle at 52%, far below the market's 72%, with the passing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Seahawks.
